copy.headline: Medical ethics expert weighs in on Dallas organ donation dispute
copy.caption: A medical ethics expert says Baylor University Medical Center may have little choice in a legal dispute over organ donation from a 38-year-old brain-dead woman. The woman's family opposes the donation, prompting a lawsuit and an emergency request for a Dallas County court to intervene.
